name: column-base
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE individual modular carved stone piece for a premium stylized tropical ruin game environment. It will be a separate 3D asset combined with many other pieces into an authored temple. Muted warm limestone/sage-grey stone with cool dark recesses, pale warm worn bevels; tiny restrained moss patches only in a few creases. Strong sculpted rounded bevels and broad planes, deliberate geometric motifs, painterly material with restrained detail and no noisy micro-scratches. No bright metallic gold. Neutral studio illumination, entire isolated object on plain light grey, no ground, no scenery, no text, no dimension lines or watermark. Three-quarter orthographic view, full top and two faces readable, generous border. A square stepped COLUMN BASE only, no column above. 2.6m wide by 0.8m tall by 2.6m deep. Two gently projecting square bevelled stone courses support a smaller flat 1.65m square seating pad on top. A simple recessed horizontal green-grey band around the middle, solid warm-grey stone above and below. Each course is robust and worn at a few corners, visually hand-sculpted. Mostly quiet surfaces, no lettering, no intricate relief. Clean flat bottom and top for stacking. One coherent plinth module.
